company_name: Jisheng Micro (Shanghai) Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Jisheng Microelectronics specializes in the localization of key semiconductor components and services, directly supporting domestic semiconductor manufacturers.
summary: Founded in 2021, Jisheng Microelectronics focuses on providing comprehensive semiconductor manufacturing solutions, including quartz and silicon components, silicon carbide materials, and vacuum pump repair services. The company has established mass production capabilities and offers over 100 product types used in various semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai with R&D centers and manufacturing bases in Shaoxing, Ningbo, and Wuhan.
